name: TeamStarWolf - The Year 2000 in Intrusions
description: Curated case-study layer, not an official MITRE mapping. ATT&CK Enterprise techniques that the verified 2000 record supports: the 22 CERT/CC advisories CA-2000-01 to CA-2000-22 (Stacheldraht, Love Letter, the BIND, wu-ftpd, rpc.statd and LPRng server flaws, Naptha) and the incident notes IN-2000-01 to IN-2000-10 (Windows trinoo, network.vbs, the 911 worm, nameserver amplification, mstream, BubbleBoy and kak, double file extensions, IRIX telnetd and the automated rpc.statd and wu-ftpd attacks), Microsoft's MS00-078, the press record of the February denial-of-service attacks, the Justice Department's 2000 prosecutions (Iffih, Lloyd, Diekman, Torricelli, c0mrade, HV2K, the Bloomberg extortion, Gorshkov and Ivanov) and the 2017 Moonlight Maze research on the relays. No 2000 source prints an ATT&CK id: every entry is this study's later mapping. The Maroochy Shire techniques are in the separate ATT&CK for ICS layer navigator/case-studies/chronicle-2000-ics.json. Each comment names source numbers from case-studies/CHRONICLE_2000.md. Scores: 70 the source describes the behavior and the study assigns the id, 50 only a Reported source supports the behavior, 40 the mapping is Inferred.
